{{tocright}}The below tables list [[Faction]] upgrades, intended mostly for [[Merc Builds|Mercenary Builds]], and listed by Tier (as we are limited to 4 upgrades per tier). These tables are sortable by "'''What it does'''" and "'''What it is based on'''". The "type" and "based on" inputs are simplified, they do not differentiate between building types. Also, for better sort-ability, they have also been re-interpreted: there is no plural form and "Building production" is listed as "Production from Buildings <abbr title="Production">P</abbr>(<abbr title="Building">B</abbr>); "Click Reward" > "Production from the clicks" <abbr title="Production">P</abbr>(click), so they can be sorted under "P".

"Based On Timings" are for upgrades that has some time element mixed into their scaling, being blank generally means that the number is calculated from something discrete to the run itself. Values suggest when they are 'reset' and you can work on their perks over multiple softer resets. (Era/Reincarnation/All Time)

Most upgrades do not have individual pages, but a few especially important or historical ones may have additional notes.

== Notes ==

* Upgrade data is copied from the individual Faction pages.
* Building names are alignment dependent on Tiers 4-11, except for Reincarnation based upgrades. (ex: highest amount of ''Hell Portals'' this Reincarnation is '''NOT''' ''Heaven's Gates or Ancient Pyramids'')
* NB@editors: All characters, including spaces, count towards the sorting order of the tables.
* '''Formulas are currently not consistent''', refer to in game live numbers to confirm calculations.
